description: This Java source file defines the class ProductPromoContentWrapper, which implements ContentWrapper. It manages retrieval, caching, and rendering of product promotional content within the OFBiz framework. The class provides methods to generate content as text, utilizing cache and external content sources, and supports integration with HTTP requests and content management components.
